attchmntText: Disclosure of Newspaper Advertisement - information regarding 40th Annual General Meeting of the Company.
voiceSummary: K.S. Oils Limited published a newspaper advertisement on November 21, 2026, regarding its 40th Annual General Meeting scheduled for December 18, 2026, at 03:00 PM via video conferencing. The company is acquired by Soy-Sar Edible Private Limited. Assam Power Distribution Company Limited invited tenders for electrification in Cachar District, with bid submission starting November 23, 2026, and closing December 8, 2026. Lakshmi Cargo Company Limited filed Form INC-25A to convert from a public to a private limited company, following a special resolution passed on November 9, 2026.

attchmntText: K S Oils Limited has informed the Exchange about "Newspaper Publication   Notice regarding Special Window for Re-lodgement of Transfer Requests of Physical Shares"
voiceSummary: K.S. Oils Limited has published a notice regarding the Special Window for Transfer and Dematerialisation of Physical Securities. The window remains open until February 04, 2027. This applies to transfer requests for shares purchased prior to April 01, 2019. It covers shares not previously lodged for transfer or those rejected due to deficiencies. The notice was published on November 19, 2026. It appeared in Business Standard English New Delhi Edition and Business Standard Hindi Bhopal Edition. The notice is also available on the company website at www.ksoils.in. L&T Finance has extended the timeline for submission of Expression of Interest for bidding for AIF Fund Units. The deadline was extended to November 27, 2025.

attchmntText: K S Oils Limited has informed the Exchange about the publication of Corrigendum to Extracts of Un-Audited financial result of 2nd quarter & half year ended, September 30, 2026.
K S Oils Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the Un-Audited (Standalone) Financial results of 2nd quarter & half year ended September 30, 2026.
K S Oils Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  M/S Ernst & Young LLP. as Internal Auditor of the company for the Financial Year 2026-27.
K S Oils Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
